title: TSMC Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results (SEC-filed Exhibit 99.1)
publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Second-quarter revenue was US$40.20 billion, diluted EPS was US$4.31 per ADR, and management guided third-quarter revenue to US$44.6-45.8 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed release provides current revenue, margins, ADR earnings, node mix, share count, and third-quarter guidance for the scenario valuation.
